title: The Rewind: You Can’t Predict. You Can Prepare.
summary:
Now, I think an important thing for people to understand is what is the nature of risk and what is the
nature of loss? Risk is the possibility of a bad outcome. Something can be risky
for a long time and not produce losses if bad things don't happen in the environment.
